_about: The check list for .github/workflows/checks.yml. One entry = one GitHub job (except job 'logic', run by the logic job).
tier: logic (game logic, the same on desktop and phone, run ONCE on the low tier), desktop (graphics, high tier only), phone (phone screen fit / overlap).
quality: the graphics tier the check opens (low, high, both, auto = no ?quality in the address). timeout: minutes for the check itself.
args: {dist} = absolute path of the built dist/ folder, {out} = a scratch folder for pictures (not uploaded).
pass / fail: line patterns (JavaScript regex); default ^\s*PASS\b and ^\s*FAIL\b. A check fails if it prints a fail line, exits non-zero, times out, or prints no pass/fail line at all.

checks.name: mousecheck
checks.note: the mouse-hint FAIL is the same on high (CI Nov 18), so it is a game result; low is 8x faster
